title: Filming: Imagine by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono continued filming material for their feature film Imagine on 5 September 1971.

This was the first filming session for the project since 23 July, and the first since the couple’s relocation to New York City.

The filming took place in Manhattan on Labor Day. Two limousines were brought to the shoot, one containing Lennon, Ono, their assistant May Pang, and Ono’s clothes. The other vehicle contained the equipment and the film crew: Doug Ibold, Bob Fries, and Steve Gebhardt.

They began by shooting scenes at a sculpture garden at 77 Water Street, including some stop-motion footage. They then moved to the East Coast Memorial in Battery Park, and Wall Street.

A followed where Lennon and Ono walked down Pine Street towards Broadway, followed by scenes by Emilio’s restaurant in Greenwich Village. The day’s final location was the 79th Street Boat Basin, where Lennon and Ono were filmed looking towards the marina and walking to the cafe.
